events.title: Indeterminacy in Music and Life
events.description: Coming soon! This music therapy workshop series invites participants to explore the experience of uncertainty in life, the comfort of predictability, and what it feels like to let go of control, through the lens of indeterminate and chance-based music. Participants will learn about influential composers (Cage, Reich, Feldman, Cardew, Oliveros) and the styles and philosophies behind indeterminate, process-based, and chance music. Experiment with your own creations inspired by these composers, perform group compositions and improvisations, and reflect on your personal relationship with uncertainty, both in music and in life. All levels of music experience welcome.

events.title: Neurodivergent Music Therapy: Song Sharing and Discussion - Holiday Season
events.description: 'Tis the season for sharing and connection! Join our festive open discussion for music lovers. We'll listen to holiday tunes and heartwarming songs, and talk about the memories and feelings they evoke. Share a song that defines your holiday season—whether it's classic carols, festive pop, or a wintery ballad—and tell us the story behind it.
